section_summary.extract_value: This is a 'Data analysis' section describing the statistical methods used to analyze study data. The section details the use of IBM SPSS Statistics for descriptive and correlational analyses, including Pearson correlations between BMI, social safeness (SSPS), body appreciation (BAS-2), inflexible eating (IEQ), and disordered eating (EDE-Q). Path analyses were conducted using AMOS to examine whether the relationship between social belonging/safeness and disordered eating was mediated by body appreciation and inflexible eating, with BMI controlled as a confounding variable. Goodness-of-fit indices (Chi-square, CFI, TLI, RMSEA) and bootstrap resampling with 5000 samples were used to assess model plausibility and significance of mediational paths.
